annotation.title_clean: 貨物自動車運送事業輸送安全規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance on Transport Safety in the Freight Motor Vehicle Transport Business
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport (now Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance setting transport safety obligations for freight motor vehicle operators: safety management rules, driver hours, roll calls, records, and operations manager qualifications. Includes provisions for specified automated-operation freight vehicles, requiring a safety attendant on board or remote monitoring, with cybersecurity and system-setting checks. Revised effective April 2026.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators must have a specified automated-operation safety attendant on board or remote monitoring via remote surveillance devices (Art. 3-2).
Operators must build systems to ensure safety measures for automated freight operations and supervise attendants.
Roll call must confirm automated driving device settings for attendants (Art. 7).
Designated large operators must include cybersecurity in safety management rules (Art. 2-5).
Operators must keep accident, driver and operation records and publish safety information annually.
